description:
DeriveCallGraphComponent(f) re-walks f's whole reachable cone on every wake (collect_static_graph), discovering it one blocked evaluation per layer, then runs a private SCC (strong_component). transport.rs statically_reaches is a second private walker over the same edges. Design tried here: one cumulative fact Reaches(f) = edges(f) joined with Reaches(g) for each direct callee g, Recursive(f) = f in Reaches(f), CallGraphComponent(f) = min over m in {f} plus Reaches(f) with f in Reaches(m) from a settled read of Reaches(f), transport's question = owner in Reaches(from); delete collect_static_graph, strong_component, statically_reaches. Patch: session scratchpad kdt98-2-reaches.patch (uncommitted, live in fz-wt-98).

RESULT 2026-09-16: answers exactly right (corpus canon 548/548, 00181 component map identical) but census up: 00181 job starts 443 -> 532, json_roundtrip 4527 -> 5705 (DeriveCallGraphComponent 139 -> 646, 280 of them quiet runs that changed nothing; DeriveReaches 668). Not committed.

MECHANISM, from the telemetry records and scheduler.rs, not from the builder's story. The scheduler's wake order is NOT the cause. The quiescence drain (Scheduler::settle_quiescent_fact) certifies as settled every fact that is locally settled (its own publisher not dirty) and not yet quiet, whenever the agenda empties. The agenda empties at every STALL: a blocked waiter's missing producer is only demanded at that same drain point (BlockedWaiterExpansion), so on json_roundtrip the compile passes 155 (base) / 189 (Reaches tree) quiescence points, one per discovery layer, and at each one everything above the missing layer is certified. The drain does not look beneath the fact: a read of a fact whose publisher is dirty (still waiting) does not stop certification, and FactTable::is_quiet treats an ABSENT fact as quiet ("no publisher is deriving them") even when a blocked waiter is about to demand it. Measured on json_roundtrip, Reaches tree: 84 Reaches certifications at drains, 42 later overtaken by a higher revision; Reaches(0) (main) certified 15 times, its content moved 9 times, never settled by its own publication (all 30 movements settled=false). The component job waits Settled(Reaches(f)), discharges on the premature certification (main's first unblocked run happened with 133 of the 140 member Reaches facts not yet created), publishes from a partial cone, and records settled reads on absent members; every later member creation, movement and re-certification wakes it: main's component ran 110 times (pattern blocked, changed, quiet, blocked, quiet, ...). The old walk was immune only because it published nothing until the cone was complete, so it had no fact for the drain to certify and no settled reader to wake. The same premature certification already happens in the BASE on other cumulative facts each json_roundtrip compile: CallSiteSummary 545, CallSiteTargets 443, ActivationAnalyzed 111, ReturnType 77 certifications later overtaken by a higher revision (the drains wake DeriveExecutableFacts 143 times). Reaches(f) is monotone and the join is exact; Recursive and CallGraphComponent moved only from partial to complete, never from complete to different, so no answer was wrong at the end.

Secondary: derive_reaches records a read AND a wait on each absent callee fact; with reads sufficient for a wake the waits only add a blocked evaluation per absent callee (209 on json_roundtrip). Also found: statically_reaches is reflexive by construction (function == owner tested before consuming any edge) and 00346_self_apply_tail_call's transport cut depends on it; undocumented today.

Consequence: this ticket is blocked on the drain's certification rule, not refuted. A fact is not settled while any publisher in its transitive ground is dirty or while a blocked waiter beneath it names an absent fact; certification at a drain is legitimate only for a cycle whose ground is fully quiet. With that rule the settled wait discharges once per function and the component publishes once. Unmeasured until the rule exists.
title: Reachability is one monotone formula per function; the component cone walk and the transport reachability walk go away
